mapper.select: SELECT qb.id AS bank_id, qb.bank_name, count(uqa.id) AS wrong_question_count FROM user_question_answer uqa INNER JOIN question_bank qb ON qb.id = uqa.bank_id AND qb.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN category_sub_module csm ON csm.id = qb.sub_module_id AND csm.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN category_module cm ON cm.id = csm.module_id AND cm.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN category_group cg ON cg.id = cm.group_id AND cg.is_deleted = 0 WHERE uqa.user_id = #{userId} AND uqa.is_deleted = 0 AND uqa.is_correct = 0 AND cg.group_type = #{groupType} GROUP BY qb.id, qb.bank_name ORDER BY qb.id DESC
SELECT uqa.question_id, uqa.question_type FROM user_question_answer uqa WHERE uqa.user_id = #{userId} AND uqa.bank_id = #{bankId} AND uqa.is_correct = 0 AND uqa.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY id DESC

SELECT cg.group_type FROM question_bank qb INNER JOIN category_sub_module csm ON csm.id = qb.sub_module_id AND csm.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN category_module cm ON cm.id = csm.module_id AND cm.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN category_group cg ON cg.id = cm.group_id AND cg.is_deleted = 0 WHERE qb.id = #{bankId} AND qb.is_deleted = 0
